title: SealedBody
description: The sealed-body wire shape (src/protocol.zig Relic struct). Spike target #2: required content hash + required guild fingerprint + optional reveal hint + optional epoch-time gate. Captures the 'sealed body' framing — bytes32 + fp + open string + tag-1 epoch — that the Relic variant inlines on ball.dreamball.relic envelopes.

sealed-payload-hash.$comment: fp:bytes32 — blake3 of the sealed inner envelope bytes.

unlock-guild.$comment: fp:bytes32 — Guild fingerprint authorised to unlock this relic.

sealed-until.$comment: Optional time-gate; RFC 3339 at JSON, tag-1 epoch-time at CBOR.
